A M Custom Effects browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal A M Custom Effects Crazyboy - Double Fuzz Published on May 16, 2010 A M Custom Effects fuzz pedal Controls A Volume controls the output volume of the effect Fuzz controls the amount of fuzz B Gain controls the input level of the effect. At higher gain settings a lot of effects can go into overdrive or distortion. Volume controls the output volume of the effect Fuzz controls the amount of fuzz Footswitches A/B switches between the fuzz channels Information A&M Custom Effects CrazyBoy is Custom Hand Made,100% analog guitar double fuzz pedal. This pedal made specially for "Fuzz Lover" guitarists, because that pedal have absolutely two different characters, Germanium and Silicon Transistor Fuzz (two in one)so,that pedal is very universal. Specifications: Durable Silver polychrome diecast aluminum enclosure, IPV5 standard Pedal Dimensions 119x94x34mm (4.67"x3.68"x1.18") Black pointer knobs Red ultrabright 5mm LEDs with wide view angle Chrome LED sockets Separate Volume and Fuzz controls A/B Switch lets you choose between Germanium and Silicon Transistor Fuzz Heavy Duty True Bypass Standard 9V DC power supply or 9V battery (included) Polarity protection Additional filtering for power supply 1% tolerance metalfilm resistors Point to point wiring Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet + Add your review Links A&M Custom Effects A&M Custom Effects Crazyboy - Double Fuzz Where to find one?
